audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings credit Null Sphere (Q) with a silence and call Kassadin's damage reduction a 'magic shield (passive)'. Riot's text gives Q no silence — it interrupts channels — and Void Stone (P) is flat magic damage reduction, not a shield; the shield is on Q. The page also frames Riftwalk as a cooldown to track and wait out, when Riftwalk's cooldown is 5/3.5/2 seconds and mana is the real limiter.
audit.why: enemyKit Q: 'fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and interrupting channels. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.' enemyKit P: 'takes reduced magic damage and ignores unit collision.' enemyKit R cd: 5/3.5/2, cost 40 and rising per stack. Nautilus has no channel for a Q interrupt to matter, so the silence advice was steering the player off a non-existent threat.
audit.corrected: Silence claims removed from whys[6] and late; Void Stone and Null Sphere named for what they actually do; Riftwalk reframed as a 2-second blink limited by mana, with the real answer stated — Dredge Line and the passive root stop it only while he is CC'd, and Nether Blade (W) is an auto-attack reset that tells you the burst is coming.

edits.before: This is lost if it goes long and you know it. By 2+ items Kassadin blinks in, his passive magic shield soaks your Depth Charge burst, and his Q silence shuts off your re-engage — he kills you before your CC chain even resolves. Your only value late is being a CC-bot for your team: save your R for him in fights, peel your carries, and never facecheck for a man who can Riftwalk on top of you. The game had to be won before his items came online.
edits.after: This is lost if it goes long and you know it. By 2+ items Kassadin blinks in, Void Stone's magic damage reduction blunts your Depth Charge and Null Sphere's shield eats the rest — he kills you before your CC chain resolves. Your only value late is being a CC-bot for your team: save your R for him in fights, peel your carries, and never facecheck for a man whose Riftwalk is a 2-second cooldown. The game had to be won before his items came online.

edits.before: Kassadin's Riftwalk (R) comes online — every Q you land he blinks out of, and his stacking blink turns your CC chain into wasted cooldowns.
edits.after: Kassadin's Riftwalk (R) comes online at a 5s cooldown — he blinks before your Q arrives, and your CC chain burns for nothing unless it lands first.

edits.before: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Riftwalk is a 2s cooldown, not a window — mana limits it. Engage while he is CC'd, not after.

edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — Riftwalk costs 40 mana and stacks; mana, not cooldown, limits it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Kassadin's Riftwalk: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. When it is down — Hook + passive root chain.
